notes.title: Paladin 1.1.3.0 Released
notes.content:
Bug fixes

* Intermittent crash bug on Endurance when using nuke
* Cities not damaged on Endurance when tutorial had not been completed

Gameplay changes

* Scoring tweaks to new game styles with respect to difficulty levels

notes.title: Paladin update published
notes.content:
Hi folks,

I’ve just published an update to Paladin. I’ve added 4 new game styles, a couple of extra ships and some new pesky aliens. Hope you enjoy it.

See you on the leaderboards!

Cheers,
Paul :-)

notes.title: Paladin update - in the works
notes.content:
Hi all,

Sorry for the radio silence! I've had a mad, crazy year porting Paladin to the Xbox One console but it finally arrived at the start of December. Phew!

So, that's cool, yeah, but what does that mean for the Steam version and PC gamers? Well, it means I finally have time to add some new features! Nothing is set in stone yet, but I'm thinking extra game modes, maybe a new ship and possibly some extra levels / alien invaders!

I'll post news and updates as they happen on Twitter, @PumpkinGames.

Keep 'em peeled here for an official announcement when it's all done.

Merry Christmas & Happy New Year
